spec_type_rationale: existing Tabs.css renders accent-as-text (real) plus stale design tokens; fix = token sync + 2 accent swaps

findings.content: Design source declares AA-darkened light tokens: --text-muted #6c6c75, --text-faint #6e6e77 (already fixed at source).
Design source dark --text-faint #787881; dark --text-muted #a1a1aa unchanged (already matched app).
design/styles.css is the design source of truth; both tokens.css and design-fidelity-contract §5 derive from it — sync target, do not hand-edit derivatives.
App light tokens are STALE: --text-muted #71717a (should be #6c6c75), --text-faint #a1a1aa (should be #6e6e77).
App dark --text-faint #71717a is stale (should be #787881); dark --text-muted #a1a1aa already correct.
Full token diff: ONLY these 3 color values drifted; every other token matches design/styles.css — the fix is a 3-value sync, nothing more.
Tabs.css:149 active label color:var(--accent) = 2.29/2.54:1 — genuine fail, independent of token drift; needs var(--text).
Tabs.css:233 active-badge text color:var(--accent) on var(--accent-soft) — genuine accent-as-text fail; needs var(--text).
Tabs.css:97 inactive (var(--text-muted)), :326 close (var(--text-faint)), :388 dirty-dot bg (var(--text-faint)) all reach AA via the token sync — no per-site swap needed.
Tabs.css:480-481 .tabbar active override sets only box-shadow+background -> inherits line 149 color; one active-label swap covers both variants.
Confirmed root cause for the active label: decorative --accent used as text (2.29/2.54:1); probe validated var(--text) passes.

SUPERSEDED premise: research assumed no token between --text-muted and --text and proposed a new --text-secondary; the design source already darkened --text-muted/--text-faint, so no new token is needed.
Research's systemic finding (--text-muted used as text in ~18 sites) is RESOLVED by the token sync here, not deferred to a follow-up ramp spec.
§6.3 Search Before Building — sync existing tokens; invent no new token.
Prefer design tokens over literals; never inline styles — changes are token values + var() refs only.
§2.2 renderer tier: tokens live in styles/tokens.css; molecule CSS under molecules/.
tokens.css is the renderer design-token SSOT — the correct single edit point for a value sync.
Styling: semantic classes bound to tokens; no inline styles.
Tabs is accessibility-conscious (hand-rolled WAI-ARIA to pass axe) — a contrast fix is in-character; color-only, engine untouched.
CT fidelity tests must reproduce full styling context (tokens.css import + data-theme + production className scope).
Do not global-import base.css in CT (breaks screenshot baselines); scope box-sizing to the fixture.
Single-variant CT lets others ship broken — cover BOTH light and dark themes.
Contract §5 (lines 130,133) prescribes var(--text-muted)/var(--text-faint) — already correct once tokens sync; no amendment needed.
Contract derives from design/styles.css; hand-editing §5 would desync it from its source.
Contract idiom promotes selected/active text to var(--text) (body-radio.active) — grounds the active-label + badge swaps.
005: active-tab label var(--accent) fails 1.4.3 (2.29/2.54:1) — the genuine accent swap.
Pre-existing; surfaced by design-auditor during feature 011; file Tabs.css.
Severity Warning, Status Open.

No new token, no contract amendment (user correction: the tokens were merely stale).

Both themes. The dark --text-faint sync (#787881 = 4.58:1) plus unchanged dark --text-muted (#a1a1aa = 7.81:1) and dark --text (18.21:1) clear AA in dark too; ACs verify both themes.

mandatory_reads.n_a_reason: CSS/token-only change; consuming components apply class tokens unchanged — no caller code touched by a token-value sync or a color-property swap.
git log on Tabs.css consulted inline earlier: defect pre-existing since 002-tabs-primitive; token staleness predates the contrast tickets.

overview: The working-tabs strip renders two accent-colored roles below WCAG 2.1 AA, and separately the app's design tokens are STALE relative to design/styles.css (their declared source of truth): the muted and faint text tokens were already darkened for AA at the source but never synced into src/renderer/styles/tokens.css. This spec (1) syncs the three drifted token values to design/styles.css — which brings every --text-muted / --text-faint text consumer app-wide to AA in one edit — and (2) swaps the two genuine accent-on-light sites in Tabs.css to var(--text). No new token and no contract amendment are needed.
current_state: The app tokens in src/renderer/styles/tokens.css have drifted from design/styles.css (the design source of truth): light --text-muted is #71717a but the source declares #6c6c75; light --text-faint is #a1a1aa but the source declares #6e6e77; dark --text-faint is #71717a but the source declares #787881 (dark --text-muted #a1a1aa already matches). This staleness is why the inactive-tab label (Tabs.css:97, var(--text-muted)) measures 4.36:1 and the close-button icon (Tabs.css:326, var(--text-faint)) measures 2.31:1 — both sub-AA. Two failures are independent of the token drift: the active-tab label (Tabs.css:149, color:var(--accent) #10b981) at 2.29:1 / 2.54:1 and the active-tab badge text (Tabs.css:233, color:var(--accent) on var(--accent-soft)); accent fails as text regardless of the muted/faint values. The dirty-dot indicator (Tabs.css:388, background:var(--text-faint)) also rides on the faint token. The .tabbar active override (Tabs.css:480-481) sets only box-shadow + background, so it inherits the active-label color from line 149. design-fidelity-contract §5 (lines 130, 133) prescribes var(--text-muted) / var(--text-faint) — already correct once the tokens sync. Pre-existing; surfaced by design-auditor during feature 011 review.
desired_behavior: Sync the three drifted token values in src/renderer/styles/tokens.css to design/styles.css: light --text-muted -> #6c6c75, light --text-faint -> #6e6e77, dark --text-faint -> #787881 (dark --text-muted stays #a1a1aa). Post-sync, the inactive-tab label reads 4.69:1, the close-button icon 4.55:1 light / 4.58:1 dark, and the dirty-dot 4.55:1 — all clearing their WCAG AA thresholds in both themes, and every other --text-muted / --text-faint text consumer app-wide is simultaneously brought to AA. Separately, swap the two accent-on-light sites in Tabs.css to var(--text): active-tab label (149) and active-tab badge text (233); the .tabbar variant inherits line 149. No new token is introduced (no --text-secondary), the existing token names and semantics are preserved, and design-fidelity-contract §5 is NOT hand-edited — it already matches the synced tokens, and editing it would desync it from design/styles.css.

affected_areas.impact: Sync 3 drifted values to design/styles.css: light --text-muted->#6c6c75, light --text-faint->#6e6e77, dark --text-faint->#787881
Two accent-on-light swaps: active-tab label (149) and active-tab badge text (233) var(--accent)->var(--text); .tabbar inherits 149. Lines 97/326/388 unchanged (fixed by token sync)

Token darkening shifts every --text-muted/--text-faint consumer visually (Modal, Toast, Dropdown, RequestBar, TabBar, Titlebar, Statusbar, PrimitivesDemo) — affected CT screenshot baselines re-based across light+dark; Tabs CT gains contrast assertions

acceptance_criteria.statement: The design-token stylesheet shall define the muted and faint text tokens at the darkened values from the design source.
acceptance_criteria.verification_command: grep -q -- '--text-muted: #6c6c75' src/renderer/styles/tokens.css && grep -q -- '--text-faint: #6e6e77' src/renderer/styles/tokens.css && grep -q -- '--text-faint: #787881' src/renderer/styles/tokens.css

acceptance_criteria.statement: The system shall preserve the existing token names and semantics, introducing no new color token.
WHILE either theme is active, the Tabs strip shall keep the active-tab and inactive-tab labels visually distinct.
The system shall bring every muted and faint text role to the WCAG AA contrast minimum by syncing the token values to the design source.
WHILE either theme is active, the active-tab label shall meet the WCAG AA contrast minimum for normal text by using var(--text), which the tabbar variant inherits.
WHILE a tab is active, the active-tab badge text shall meet the WCAG AA contrast minimum for normal text on the accent-soft background by using var(--text).
WHILE either theme is active, the inactive-tab label shall meet the WCAG AA contrast minimum for normal text via the synced var(--text-muted).
WHILE either theme is active, the close-button icon shall meet the WCAG AA non-text contrast minimum via the synced var(--text-faint).
WHILE a tab is marked dirty, the dirty-state indicator shall meet the WCAG AA non-text contrast minimum via the synced var(--text-faint).
The system shall pass lint and type-check on all changed files.
acceptance_criteria.verification_command: npm run lint && npm run typecheck

out_of_scope.content: Disabled-tab label color (Tabs.css:174/183, var(--text-faint)) — WCAG exempts disabled UI from the contrast minimum; left as-is (rides the synced faint anyway).
Any token drift beyond the three contrast-relevant values (e.g. the app-only dark --m-head token absent from design/styles.css) — not reconciled here.
Hand-editing design-fidelity-contract §5 — the contract derives from design/styles.css and is already correct post-sync; editing it would desync it from its source.

constraints.content: Must follow WCAG 2.1 AA — SC 1.4.3 (normal text) and SC 1.4.11 (non-text UI), in both light and dark themes.
Search for an existing utility/token before building — sync the existing muted/faint tokens rather than inventing a new one.
Prefer design tokens over literal style values; never use inline styles — changes are token values plus var() references only.
tokens.css must mirror design/styles.css (the design source of truth); token values are synced from it, not hand-picked, and derived docs (contract §5) are not hand-edited.
Renderer tier: design tokens live in styles/tokens.css; molecule CSS under molecules/.
The active-tab badge and Tabs WAI-ARIA engine must remain intact; the fix is color/token-only.

risks.risk: Token sync darkens muted/faint text across ~9 other components (Modal, Toast, Dropdown, RequestBar, TabBar, Titlebar, Statusbar, PrimitivesDemo); their CT screenshot baselines shift, not just Tabs.
risks.mitigation: Enumerate all --text-muted/--text-faint consumers; re-baseline every affected CT across light+dark. These are design-source-authoritative changes (intended), not regressions.

risks.risk: CT single-variant baseline misses the dark theme; a color-only shortcut could leave other drift.
risks.mitigation: Cover BOTH themes in CT; verify at runtime via design-auditor, not just static/CT.

risks.risk: .tabbar active-label inheritance assumption wrong (line 149 not inherited by the tabbar variant).
risks.mitigation: Confirmed: Tabs.css:480-481 sets only box-shadow+background; CT must assert the active-label color in both bare .tabs and .tabbar scopes.
